title: podnet pod --report
description: The report of one run of podnet pod. The pod writes it when it starts (exit is null) and again when it ends.

backend.description: The backend that runs the program, or null when no backend was chosen or none could start.

choice.description: The reason of the choice of the backend, or null when none was chosen.

hold.description: The hold level of the backend, in the words of podnet pod doctor --json: enforced (the kernel keeps the program in its network namespace), advisory (the supervisor holds the calls that it intercepts) or none.

not_held.description: The ways out that the backend does not hold.

udp_limit.description: The most bytes of a UDP datagram that the backend carries, or null when it has no limit (or no backend).

exit.description: The exit status of podnet pod: null until the run ends.

reason.description: The cause of a failure (exit 3, 64), or null.
